item.title: About
item.description: About Me Hi, I’m Hubert Olejnik, a passionate graphics programmer and game developer. Welcome to my blog where I document my journey through the fascinating world of graphics programming and game development. My Background I have been involved in the tech industry for over a decade, with a deep focus on computer graphics, real-time rendering, and game development. My experience spans various programming languages, game engines, and graphics APIs.
